notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened Release Date Revealed
notes.notes:
Greetings detectives,

The sun has risen, and the fog dissipates as today is a big day! Firstly, our release date trailer is here so watch it now! Experience a tale of untold Lovecraft-based horror with a cult appearing from a dark abyss to wreck all that we hold dear. Will we cure madness or be driven deeper into its grasp?

[previewyoutube=wV0Dmvxjld4;full][/previewyoutube]
This story will be in your hands when Sherlock Holmes The Awakened releases on April 11, 2023! Write it down on a piece of paper and nail it on a wall nearby.

Sherlock Holmes The Awakened will be available in three editions: Standard Edition, Deluxe Edition (includes The Whispered Dreams DLC - bonus side quests and 6 new outfits) and Premium Edition (the above plus digital artbook and soundtrack).

Pre-order today to receive an additional 3 custom The Sleuth’s Attire outfits for Holmes as a bonus.
We cannot wait to share this adventure with you. Not long to go now. 

See you soon,
Your Team Frogwares

notes.title: Free Sherlock Holmes Chapter One “Plague Doctor” DLC and Major Update are here!
notes.notes:
Hello detectives, 

They say that the best things in life are free. Is this true? Well, we’re not entirely sure. So to test this theory, we’ve decided to release a DLC pack featuring some brand-new outfits all for free. As of right now, you have two new outfits to try out - the classic Plague Doctor costume and the scientifically proven highly sophisticated Laboratory Coat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5978908/1f48ef4eb16d77cfc0ca5aec42c359375585fdcb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5978908/1cd00ba6a632f430ab7189bf582a5c8883f7aaf9.png

We also have a brand new patch that improves performance, gets rid of nasty bugs, improves the quality of life, and adds a few smaller features. You can see the detailed list right below the post.

Catch the fever young Sherlock. It’s time to diagnose who the culprit is. And if you love taking screenshots of our game and you decide to use our new outfits, do send your screens to us! We love seeing what you all come up with. 

Thanks again for all your support and we hope you'll enjoy your new outfits. 


Regards,

Your Frogwares Team

Click below to buy Sherlock Holmes Chapter One on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137300/Sherlock_Holmes_Chapter_One/

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One release date revealed, preorders now live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Many of you were wondering when Sherlock Holmes Chapter One will be released. It’s a question that many of you have been asking us for months. Now, we can tell you the big news. Ladies and gentlemen, here it is. Get yourself comfortable and watch our new trailer and find out when you can play Sherlock Holmes Chapter One!

[previewyoutube=VLT_7TPx53U;full][/previewyoutube]

Ladies and gentlemen, Sherlock Holmes Chapter One Release Date is November 16th, 2021.

And as an icing on the cake, we have one more surprise for you. We have an all new, narrated gameplay video for you to watch and analyse. In it, we will show you more of what awaits you once you arrive in Cordona. See how the Holmes family mansion looks like, how combat works, what difficult options you will have, and loads more. Check it out right here below.

[previewyoutube=uaCIPhxUNI4;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, one more piece of info. Sherlock Holmes Chapter One is now available to pre-order on Steam. If you pre-order our game, you will get additional goodies to keep at no cost, such as the full version of our game Sherlock Holmes Crimes and Punishments, and additional cases, outfits, and more Pre-order now so you won't miss out!

We will be revealing more and more of the game as the release date approaches, so stay tuned detectives! And as always, comment away with your thoughts below. 


Take care and speak to you soon,

Frogwares Team



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137300/Sherlock_Holmes_Chapter_One/

notes.title: SHERLOCK HOLMES CRIMES AND PUNISHMENTS' RELEASE DATE REVEALED ALONGSIDE A NEW TRAILER
notes.notes:
Holmes' biggest mystery is ready to be revealed! Sherlock Holmes Crimes and Punishments from Frogwares is releasing on September 30th for all territories, on the PS4®, PS3®, Xbox One®, Xbox 360®, and PC. 

Begin your investigation across the aforementioned major platforms spanning 6 unique cases in many different locations around 19th century London, taking advantage of his skills, with your wits. Get a 30 second dose of the intrigue and atmosphere in Sherlock Holmes Crimes & Punishments in a new trailer below. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sIVFTVjSH24

Previously, you've seen 23 minutes of gameplay, as we chartered unknown waters in the Case of Black Peter. As mentioned, there are up to 9 different conclusions to each case, and we promised we wouldn't spoil the ending. That means the murderer of Peter Carey is still on the loose, and come September 30, we can't wait for you to compare your conclusions to ours on our Facebook or Twitter accounts. 

In Crimes & Punishments you take to the streets as Victorian detective Sherlock Holmes, as you investigate alongside Scotland Yard some of the most heinous and complex crimes imaginable. In a gameplay experience designed to showcase some of Holmes' most famous skills, the investigative mechanics in Crimes & Punishments lend themselves to the cunning and skill of the player; in Sherlock Holmes Crimes & Punishments, it's his skills, your wits.

notes.title: A RELEASE DATE AND NEW SCREENSHOTS FOR CRIMES AND PUNISHMENTS!
notes.notes:
Crimes & Punishments, the new investigation game developed by Frogwares studio, is now set for release on consoles and PC on early September 2014! 

On this occasion, discover 3 new screenshots of the game, featuring Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson investigating some of the crime scenes from the 6 exceptional cases the game asks you to solve. You will have to exploit the incredible gifts and talents of Sherlock, such as his ability to guess the details of an individual's life simply by observing them, or to imagine and reconstruct a past event by studying the key features of a crime scene, in order to find out the truth. But what will you do of your suspects? Will you listen to your moral sense, or will you impartially enforce justice? 

Crimes & Punishments will be released on PC early September 2014. 

See the Images
